# Frog, phase 2: materials in Eggy 15 (exact sRGB of the ramp steps), joins, flat shading, export.
# Run after p1_blockout.txt. Generated by make_frog.py.
material new Skin --base-color 0.2353 0.6078 0.5294 --no-slot
material new Belly --base-color 0.8667 0.8314 0.7961 --no-slot
material new Eye --base-color 0.9765 0.8510 0.3333 --no-slot
material new Pupil --base-color 0.0549 0.0471 0.1059 --no-slot
select Body Head EyeL EyeR HaunchL HaunchR ArmL ArmR HandL HandR FootL FootR
material assign Skin
select Belly
material assign Belly
select IrisL IrisR
material assign Eye
select PupilL PupilR
material assign Pupil
select Body Head Belly EyeL EyeR IrisL IrisR PupilL PupilR HaunchL HaunchR ArmL ArmR HandL HandR FootL FootR
active Body
join
rename Body Frog
shade flat
inspect stats
export frog.glb
